info.title: Convoy API
info.description:
Convoy is a truck discovery and availability marketplace API.

## Authentication
1. **POST /api/auth/send-otp** then **POST /api/auth/verify-otp** to log in.
2. Use the returned **`accessToken`** as a Bearer JWT on all other endpoints:
   `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`
3. Path `user_id` must match the logged-in user (from the token).

## Interactive docs
- **Swagger UI:** `/docs`
- **ReDoc:** `/redoc`
- **OpenAPI JSON:** `/openapi.json`

## Base path
All routes are served under **`/api`**.

post.description: Send OTP to mobile number
Verify OTP and login/register user

get.description: Get list of available truck types

post.description: Update user's push notification token
Store hashed device contacts for mutual-connection matching.
Find phone-book contacts shared between the logged-in user and another user.

Autosuggest locations: DB first (min 3 chars), then Google Places.

Verify Aadhaar OTP via Cashfree and approve KYC on success.
Verify Aadhaar by uploading front/back images via Cashfree Smart OCR.
Submit KYC with document images — verified via Cashfree Smart OCR when images provided.
Add a truck for user

delete.description: Remove a vehicle and its associated posts

post.description: Verify vehicle registration via ULIP VAHAN API.
Verify driving license via ULIP SARATHI API.
Verify multiple documents in one request.
Create a truck availability post (auto-expires after 24 hours).

get.description: Get user's truck posts (active or expired).

post.description: Reactivate an expired post for another 24 hours.

put.description: Edit a truck post (vehicle, destination, current location) and reactivate/extend expiry.

post.description: Search for available trucks using PostGIS ST_DWithin.
Track failed search for smart notifications
Log call button click for analytics
Book an available truck route.
Mark notification as read
Approve or reject KYC

delete.description:
Permanently delete a user and everything tied to them: truck posts (and their
destinations), registered vehicles, KYC record, bookings (their own and other
users' bookings on their posts), search-demand tracking, notifications, call logs,
synced contacts, and pending login OTPs. Irreversible. Requires the X-Admin-Key
header in addition to a normal user JWT.

get.description: Get the logged-in user's last 10 searches or last 10 posts.

contactName.title: Contactname
contactName.description: Contact name for this post. Defaults to the user's own name if omitted.

contactNumber.title: Contactnumber
contactNumber.description: Contact number for this post. Defaults to the user's own mobile if omitted.

vehicleId.title: Vehicleid
vehicleId.description: UUID of a verified vehicle to update the post to

hashedNumber.title: Hashednumber
hashedNumber.description: SHA256 hex hash of normalized phone digits (never send raw numbers)

aadhaarFrontImage.title: Aadhaarfrontimage
aadhaarFrontImage.description: Base64 or URL of Aadhaar front

aadhaarBackImage.title: Aadhaarbackimage
aadhaarBackImage.description: Base64 or URL of Aadhaar back

otherUserId.title: Otheruserid
otherUserId.description: User ID to compare phone books against

origin.description: Required if destination is omitted — at least one of the two is needed

destination.description: Required if origin is omitted — at least one of the two is needed

truckType.title: Trucktype
truckType.description: Truck type filter. If omitted, posts of any truck type are returned.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.description: Minimum required capacity in tonnes. If omitted, posts of any capacity are returned; if set, only posts with capacity >= this value are returned.

sortBy.title: Sortby
sortBy.description: Sort results by distance to origin or destination. If omitted, defaults to combined distance (both given), or whichever single one was given. If the requested side wasn't provided in the search (e.g. nearest_origin with no origin), falls back to the default ranking instead of failing.
